about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Born in Baghdad, raised on great coffee.
about.body1: Kite Coffee Roastery is a specialty roastery based in Baghdad, Iraq. Founded in 2025, we set out with a simple belief: great coffee changes the day.
about.body2: We work directly with farmers and importers to source exceptional green beans, then roast them in small batches to bring out the best in every cup — whether you're a home enthusiast or a café owner looking for a reliable roasting partner.
about.body3: Our four pillars — Consistency, Innovation, Transparency, and Partnership — guide everything we do.
